verdict.rationale: The docs name a first-party Batch Processing API for high-volume processing and asynchronous screening for high-volume scenarios. Exports can pull whole data types over a date range. However, the batch API is only mentioned in a single line, and key per-item operations are documented as single-customer only, such as monitor configuration and status. Missing for 10: documented batch API endpoints and limits, bulk case/alert remediation or bulk monitor/unmonitor actions, hands-on or independent corroboration.
